'''Inner Beast''' is a [[magical effect]] type of [[special]] card.  It first appeared in [[The King in Yellow]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': Magical effect

'''Bonus''':
*+1 Maximum [[Stamina]]
*-2 Maximum [[Sanity]]
*+2 to [[Combat check]]s

'''Movement''':  You receive 1 extra [[movement]] point.

Discard this card if your [[Summon the Beast Within]] is refreshed or leaves your possession.
